archetypes.name: sentinel-contract
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 and hook recovery now depend on strict terminal sentinel ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 terminal sentinel contract end to end. Focus on whether step-3-terminal can only appear after current-pass result envelope persistence, whether stale sentinels are cleared before re-entry, and whether step-3 remains only a routing milestone. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: guard-whitelist
archetypes.rationale: The foreground probe whitelist must not reopen progress or result polling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review hook-bg-poll-guard.sh from a whitelist-hardening perspective. Check that only the intended terminal sentinel probes are allowed, absent sentinel WAIT is allowed, symlinked sentinels deny, and result envs, task outputs, progress artifacts, non-terminal sentinels, loops, and appended probes remain blocked. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: embedded-assets
archetypes.rationale: Runtime uses gzip-embedded legacy assets for Step 3 paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the live scripts and python/plan_review.py embedded assets together. Confirm the embedded blobs match the live Step 3 loop and state helper, and that parity tests cover future drift for both assets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
